description: Audit code for adherence to RFC 3339 (Internet date/time timestamps) and RFC 9557 (IXDTF: timestamps with [time-zone] and [key=value] suffixes, and the update that makes Z mean 'local offset unknown'). USE FOR: reviewing timestamp producers (formatters, serializers, loggers, API responses), consumers (parsers, validators, deserializers), and schemas (JSON Schema/OpenAPI format date-time/date/time, protobuf/Avro docs, DB/API contracts); running conformance vectors against a target parser in any language; statically scanning source for risky date-time APIs. DO NOT USE FOR: full ISO 8601 (week/ordinal dates, durations, intervals), RFC 5322/HTTP-date formats, or general time-zone arithmetic bugs unrelated to serialization.
